title: The first clear telling wins
text: The first clear telling wins; a recap keeps only what's new; a host one-liner can replace a guest's slow version. Weakened: the better telling wins, not always the first (1001 T7, 1120, 1117). HKS-12 overrides HKS-4 (1118).
